reviews.title: Great cooler!
reviews.comment: The Thermalright digital air cooler was easy to install. It keeps my CPU cool and nicely displays the CPU and GPU temperature and loads. The noise is much quieter than my previous stock cooler. BTW, this cooler came with thermal paste, but the paste is difficult to apply and you're better off buying a different paste instead.
reviews.author: RC

reviews.title: Keeps it cool
reviews.comment:
This is a great cooler. I haven't seen my CPU go above 70C even at 100% load during stress tests. It keeps it in the 50's during normal use. The screen is great for being able to see how my CPU and GPU are performing at a glance, but it does require you to run software in the background.
The only reason I knocked off a star is for the noise level. The fans are not as quiet as other coolers I've tried, especially running at 100%. They have a slight whine to them when they really get going. It doesn't bother me so much as I usually wear headphones while gaming and can't hear them at all, but someone looking for a quiet CPU cooler should look elsewhere.
reviews.author: Captain Awesome

reviews.title: Excellent Cooler for Hot CPU
reviews.comment: I rarely put reviews online, but this product shows its magic with its cooling power. I had a single tower noctua cooler before going with the peerless assassin 120. Let me tell you with the previous max temps i was getting with my I9 10900k was 100c during gaming sessions. Now after the new cooler i am now getting 75c max. I’m totally amazed of what it did for my i9 10900k which runs hot over clocked. Call of duty 1440P Ultra settings i didnt see temps go above 50c, i’m very excited of its cooling capabilities.
